comment: The whole module is monophonic per side. The damping is worked out from the Cf knob as a one-pole coefficient, RSC.cpp:190-195, and applied inside each delay line. The even delay lines feed the left output and the odd ones the right, RSC.cpp:206-212, with the whole mesh fed from the sum of all eight. Both inputs are also configured as bypasses to their own outputs.
